832438301.name: East Carolina
832438301.mood: Fans like where this is going

clip.headline: Pirates Finish 12-2 and Ranked No. 16, But Portal Exits Cloud the Offseason
clip.dek: East Carolina went 8-0 in conference play, then closed with losses to Memphis and Old Dominion while four players entered the transfer portal.

posts.name: Purple Gold Pete
posts.text: 12-2. Ranked 16th. 8-0 in conference. For a 2.5 star program. Say what you want about how it ended, but I'm not coming down off this one for a while. Pirate_flag has this thing humming. ARRRRGH

posts.name: Dock Street Dave
posts.text: Lost 44-14 to Memphis and then lost to Old Dominion by 3. Two straight. I'll enjoy the 12-2 but I'm not gonna pretend those two games didn't happen. Same fans who were ready to quit in September are now planning the parade.

posts.name: PirateNation_1987
posts.thread: Season Review: 12-2 and what we need to fix before next year
posts.text: Season tickets since 1987 and this is the best team I've seen in years. Beat UTSA 42-6, escaped Army 20-14, 8-0 in the league. The Memphis game was ugly, 14-44 is 14-44, and ODU by 3 hurts. But we were 16th in the country. Let's not lose perspective. Need to address the defense in the portal though.

posts.name: Katie in Section 112
posts.text: Final home game of the year. Purple everywhere. 12-2 feels unreal. Already counting down to next season 💜💛

image.caption: Packed house, barely a seat to be had

posts.name: Portal Watch Pirate
posts.text: Four to the portal including Caden Knighten, Jeremiah Favorite and Grant Brake. Wish them all the best, but that's a lot of depth walking out the door right when we've got momentum. Pirate_flag needs to reload fast.

posts.name: Linda Haskins
posts.text: I've been going to ECU games since I was a little girl and I can't remember being this proud of a team. Yes, we lost the last two, but 12 wins!!! Let's give the coaches and kids some credit. Pirates are on the map again. See everyone at the spring game. Go Pirates!!

posts.name: Tailgate Tony
posts.text: 12-2 season and they still want my whole paycheck for a hot dog and a drink. Worth it? Honestly yeah. But still 🤣

posts.name: BuccaneerBill
posts.thread: Recruiting class ranked 69th?? Should we be worried?
posts.text: I know we just won 12 and everyone's happy, but 69th in the class rankings is not where you want to be. If we're losing four to the portal AND the class is ranked 69th, that's how you go from 12-2 back to 7-5. Not panicking, just saying keep an eye on it. Coaching staff needs to sell this season harder. Where are the facilities upgrades?

posts.name: Memphis Mike (Tigers fan)
posts.text: East Carolina fans celebrating 12-2 like they didn't get run out of the building 44-14 by the Tigers. Enjoy the participation trophy, Pirates 😂

posts.name: Hot Take Harry
posts.text: Reminder that J.Smith is still on the roster after being on Portal Watch and is still buried on the depth chart. Either play the guy or let him walk. Pirate_flag, make a call. Also trust the process, we're so back.

posts.name: Randy Dobbins
posts.text: Anyone else think we should've beaten Old Dominion? 21-24 and we were ranked and they weren't (I think). Bowl game coaching was questionable. Still love this team but the play-calling at the end had me throwing my remote. We're gonna be fine. Go Pirates.

posts.name: Bandwagon Brenda
posts.text: Made this sign for the UTSA game and kept it for next season. 12-2 means we're only getting started 🏴‍☠️

image.text: 12-2 AND THE BEST IS YET TO COME. ARRRR!

832438359.name: Ohio State
832438359.mood: Fans like where this is going

clip.headline: Perfect at 16-0, Buckeyes Face Portal Exits and a Quiet Recruiting Board
clip.dek: Ohio State is the national champion and still No. 1, but five departures and a No. 138 recruiting class have some fans checking the weather.

posts.name: Buckeye Brian
posts.text: 16-0. National champs. Beat Nebraska 35-17 in the title game. I'm going to need everyone to stop refreshing the portal page and just enjoy this for a minute.

posts.name: Dottie in Section 14
posts.text: Still can't believe it. 35-17 over a No. 2 team in the title game. Been here since the Woody days and this one's going on the fridge. 🌰

posts.name: BuckIDfan_1987
posts.thread: Class ranked 138th?? Can someone explain this to me
posts.text: Not trying to rain on the parade, I know we're 16-0. But 138th in recruiting is not a typo, is it? Five guys hit the portal, including Coffey, and we're bringing in a class ranked 138th? Tuddy better know what he's doing. I've had season tickets since 1987 and I've seen programs fall off a cliff quietly.

posts.name: Rival Rick
posts.text: Lost five to the portal and the class is ranked 138th. Enjoy the trophy, Ohio State. Tuddy_roosevelt is stripping the roster for parts while you celebrate.

posts.name: Scarlet & Gray Sue
posts.text: Everyone panicking about the portal: K.Bing stayed. R.Gado stayed. K.Greene, B.Lyle, N.Lautar, C.Gaydosh all stayed. The staff talked to guys early. That's called managing a roster. 👏

posts.name: Gary Hollenbeck
posts.text: Well folks, another banner. Sixteen wins in a row is something we'll tell the grandkids about. I do worry about losing Tim Coffey, Jay Timmons and Dre Quinn all at once, those were good players. But if anyone can reload it's this staff. Go Bucks! Also $9 for a pretzel at the Shoe is highway robbery, but I'll pay it for a champion.

posts.name: Tailgate Tommy
posts.text: Made this for the next home game. We don't say the B-word around here. Coach has banned it. 🤐

posts.name: PortalWatchPete
posts.thread: MEGATHREAD: Who stayed, who left (updated daily)
posts.text: LEFT: Tim Coffey, Jay Timmons, Dre Quinn, plus two more. STAYED: K.Bing (the money talk happened and it went fine, according to a source), R.Gado, K.Greene, B.Lyle, N.Lautar, C.Gaydosh. Four of the five who left were four or five stars, so that stings, but the stay list has more names than the leave list. Reload mode.

posts.name: Doug From Dayton
posts.text: Recruiting class at 138 is the part that bugs me. We're the champs. Kids should be lining up. What are we doing on the trail, Tuddy? Fix it before it bites us.

posts.name: Kayla Moves
posts.text: Champion gear haul. Yes, I spent that much. No, I don't want to talk about it. 🏆

posts.name: Nebraska Nate
posts.text: Lost 35-17 to Ohio State in the title game. Fine. They earned it. Let's see how they like losing five to the portal and a 138th-ranked class. We'll be back.

posts.name: ShoeRow7
posts.thread: BYU 28-26 was closer than people remember
posts.text: Everyone's talking 16-0 like it was a cruise, but that bowl against No. 12 BYU came down to two points. Indiana 41-17, Florida State 31-15, Nebraska 35-17, those were comfortable. BYU wasn't. Let's remember a few bounces separate perfect from a shaky offseason narrative. Still the champs, still No. 1, still love it.

832438366.name: Penn State
factors: 5-7 falls short of what a 3.5-star program expects

clip.headline: Penn State Sheds 10 to the Portal as 5-7 Season Bleeds Into Offseason
clip.dek: Three four-stars are among the departures, while the 137th-ranked recruiting class does little to calm a restless fan base.

posts.name: Happy Valley Heartbreak
posts.text: Lost 50-14 to Indiana. Lost 45-13 to Iowa AT HOME. Ranked 102nd in the country. 102!!! We are a Big Ten program in name only. agerm40 has turned Beaver Stadium into a daycare for other teams' offenses.

posts.name: BlueWhite_Since87
posts.thread: Official Portal Exodus Thread: 10 gone, three of them four-stars. Who's turning out the lights?
posts.text: Pat Mooney. George Nsekhe. Marquez Slaughter. Seven more on top of that. Four of the ten were four- or five-star guys. I've had season tickets since 1987 and I have never seen a roster emptied like this. You can't call it a rebuild when the foundation is walking out the door. Somebody in the AD's office better be taking notes, because the kids sure aren't staying for the vibes.

posts.name: Nittany Nate
posts.text: Pullard stays. Zayas stays. Carver stays. Great! Three guys stayed and TEN left. That's not a win, that's a hostage situation with extra steps. Let's not throw a parade because the fire alarm only took out half the building.

posts.name: Lions Den Larry
posts.text: Paid full price to watch this. Section was a ghost town by the third quarter. The ushers were doing crossword puzzles. #WeAre #WeAreLeaving

posts.name: Linda Kowalczyk
posts.text: I have been going to Penn State games with my husband for over thirty years and I can't remember being this embarrassed. A 45-13 loss to Iowa at home?? Then they scrape out one win at USC and everyone acts like we've turned a corner. We haven't. The portal is open, kids are leaving, and the recruiting class is ranked 137th. Somebody please explain to me what the plan is. Because I paid for parking and a $9 pretzel and I deserve to know.

posts.name: Big Ten Brandon
posts.text: Penn State fans really thought one win at USC meant we were back. Wins at USC, then loses by 32 to Iowa the next week. We are the most emotionally exhausting 5-7 team on earth. Fire the OC. Fire the DC. Fire the punter. Fire everybody.

posts.name: TailgateTed
posts.text: The only thing hotter than this fan base is the price of a beer in Beaver Stadium. $14 for a light beer and a loss. Incredible product.

posts.name: PSU_Truth_Seeker
posts.thread: Anyone else think J. Walker's TV pitch was the only thing this staff did right all year?
posts.text: Four-star edge. Reported $270K. Sources say we sold the TV exposure harder than anyone. Fine, great, Walker signed, good for him. But what exactly is he going to be exposed to? 14-50 blowouts on national TV? We bought a megaphone to show everybody how bad we are. The NIL math in this program makes my head hurt. Nice get though, I guess. Please don't let him leave in the portal next year.

posts.name: Saquon's Cousin's Roommate
posts.text: Hire Saquon as head coach. I don't care if he's retired. I don't care if he has no experience. He can't possibly do worse than 5-7, 3-6 in the Big Ten. Put him on the headset and let's ride.

posts.name: Sideline Sue
posts.text: Made my sign before the UCLA game. Lost 31-25. Made another one after. Same sign. Same sad.

image.text: WE BEAT USC ONCE. ASK FOR A REFUND ON THE REST.

posts.name: Dave Reinholt
posts.text: Look, I get it, everybody wants to burn it down. But we lost by six to a Top 10 UCLA team, and we beat USC on the road. There's something there. Pullard, Zayas and Carver all stayed, and J. Walker signed. Maybe give it a minute before the pitchforks come out. Trust the process. (Go ahead and call me a clown, I can take it.)

posts.name: Iowa Hawkeye Hank
posts.text: Penn State fans in the replies right now: "We're a 3.5-star program!" You're a 3.5-star program ranked 102nd with the 137th-ranked recruiting class. The stars are doing a lot of heavy lifting. Thanks for the 45-13, though.
